answer: Weight follows stamped provenance, not headcount. Each fresh identity posts 600 POA bond in escrow for 6 epochs, backed by 2 vouchers with disjoint history, earning zero weight through a 4-epoch probation queue where peers audit real work. A saffron tag marks the funding root so fifty keys share one cluster weight. A hollow ballot without audited history earns zero quorum weight and cannot seal. When a gale of correlated votes lands in one epoch the whole cluster is jointly slashed, burn plus holdback forfeit, so ten fakes pay ten deposits for one vote while honest keys keep full weight.
